# Sharp Internal Corners

Concave intersections of surfaces without a radius.

<figure markdown="span">
![Sharp Internal Corners: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/sharp-internal-corners-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Sharp Internal Corners: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/sharp-internal-corners-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Concave edges without a radius, which concentrate stress.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | High |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Low |

## Values

This rule has no number to meet: when it finds the problem, it reports it as the error or warning set here.

=== "Plastic Injection Molding"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | If detected | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | Error | Not yet sourced |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | If detected | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | Warning | Published, [Fast Radius](../../citations/bibliography.md#fast-radius-mjf "Powder cakes in sharp internal corners") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "Plastic Injection Molding"

    !!! failure "Error"

        Internal Sharp Corner (`{measured}`): This concave edge disrupts plastic flow and creates a stress concentration. An internal fillet of radius 0.5x the nominal wall thickness is recommended.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Sharp internal corner (`{measured}`): powder cakes in sharp inside corners and is hard to blast out, and the corner gathers stress. Round it with a small fillet.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Sharp internal corner (`{measured}`): powder cakes in sharp inside corners and is hard to blast out, and the corner gathers stress. Round it with a small fillet.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
